warnings: Applied to runtime only. Save query rules to disk afterwards, or ProxySQL loads the previous rules at its next start.
undo: UPDATE mysql_query_rules SET active = 1 WHERE rule_id = 30; then LOAD MYSQL QUERY RULES TO RUNTIME;
title: Disable query rule 30?
description: Queries rule 30 matched go to the next matching rule, or to the user's default hostgroup.
statements: /*myflames:proxysql_op*/ UPDATE mysql_query_rules SET active = 0 WHERE rule_id = 30;
LOAD MYSQL QUERY RULES TO RUNTIME;

policy.title: Risky write
policy.text: Connection ProxySQL lab is a Development connection. myflames asks only before risky writes, and these 2 statements include one.
